buttons.label: + Add Hourly Entry
buttons.cause: onClick={() => setShowIOModal(true)} is present and correct, but the same tag carries disabled={!selectedAdmissionId}. selectedAdmissionId is only seeded by the admissions auto-select at L80-82; when the admissions feed returns [] (prod has no admitted patients) the guard never flips and the button renders permanently disabled — present but unclickable.

buttons.label: Record First Hourly Intake / Output
buttons.cause: Identical disabled={!selectedAdmissionId} guard, and it lives inside the fluidLogs.length === 0 empty-state block — i.e. both entry points into the I/O modal are disabled at the exact moment the ledger is empty and a clinician most needs to chart.

cards.name: MAP / BP
cards.verdict: STATIC — both ternary branches are string literals; no BP field is ever read. The sub-line 'Sys/Dia: 124/70' (L328) and badge 'Optimal' are literals too.

cards.name: SpO2 Oxygen
cards.verdict: BOUND with literal fallback — real column, but renders 98 whenever no ventilator row exists.

cards.name: Core Temp
cards.verdict: STATIC — no binding at all, and icu_ventilator_logs has no temperature column.
